note: Small Sierra NF campground on the north shore of Huntington Lake by the Billy Creek Guard Station museum, near the Kaiser Wilderness; paved spurs among dense fir and pine. Recreation.gov warns the spurs are tight for RVs because of the trees. --Claude
summary: Lower Billy Creek (Sierra NF): rec.gov detail/rates/catalog + FS page + imagery. FIT DROP CANDIDATE (rec.gov 'difficult to maneuver RVs due to tight spaces'). Rate $46 -> $48-52; 10 sites, 20-38 ft; $10 extra vehicle, $2 holiday; 1-day cutoff, 14 nights; season 05-15..09-12. Waterfront lakeview -> lakefront candidate (sites 004-006).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (fit/access, reviewer decides): recreation.gov 'The campground has paved parking spurs, but it can be difficult to maneuver RVs due to tight spaces and the close proximity of the trees.' Comparable to the Montana-round 'very tight' / 'limited RV access' drops. Counterpoint: posted Max Vehicle Length 35-38 ft on singles 001 and 003-006; only double 002 (20 ft) is under 23 ft.

WATERFRONT (upgrade candidate, reviewer): stored lakeview. Premium singles 004 (37.23739,-119.22866), 005 (37.23743,-119.22842) and 006 (37.23759,-119.22819), all sold nightly on rec.gov, plot ~22-25 m from Huntington Lake's high-water/beach line over mostly open ground with a few trees; that meets the ~50 m open-ground test for lakefront. Kayak test likely passes (low sandy shore on imagery), not confirmed by photos. 001-003 and 010 are further back among trees (view).
FEES: stored $46 (FS page) -> $48 standard / $52 premium (rec.gov 2026-2027 rate table and per-site prices). FS page still says $46/$51.
MIN STAY: FS '2 Night Minimum on weekends; 3 Night Minimum on holidays'; rec.gov rules set both to 0 (soft). Not written (rec.gov trusted).
